evidence: The circular rear LCD features a red pill-shaped selection button beneath the particle count readout within the translucent purple filter housing, matching the Dyson V12 Detect Slim.
contradictions: The Dyson V15 Detect display has a circular silver button below the LCD rather than a red pill-shaped button.

candidate_checks.evidence: The rear display interface features the distinctive red pill-shaped control button below the particle size readout.
V15 Detect uses a round silver selection button below the LCD display rather than a red pill button.
V16 Piston Animal features a different body design and CleanCompaktor compression assembly.
Big Ball is a floor-standing canister vacuum with a spherical wheeled base.
V8 features a perpendicular bin and lacks a rear circular particle-count LCD screen.
WashG1 is a dual-roller upright wet cleaner with twin water tanks, not a handheld stick vacuum.
